packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into one PR per repo instead of one per package

Group major updates by manager instead of one PR per package — this is the fix for the 18-PR fan-out found on MMM-Beauty 2026-08-10, where every major landed as its own PR despite dependencyDashboard-style grouping already being configured for minors
Automerge devDependencies once CI is green — they don't run in production, so a bad bump breaks the build loudly rather than shipping
Automerge patch bumps on any dependency type once CI is green — semver-safe by convention

Our own repos (reusable workflows, git-tag packages like drift-guards) skip the release-age wait and digest pinning. The wait protects against someone else's compromised release, not our own tags, and the timestamp-required default would hold a git tag with no release timestamp indefinitely. @v1 stays a tag, as the README intends
